publication.title: [v0.91.8][WP-06] Implement portable bounded execution engine
publication.body:
Closes #5340

Introduces the independent portable `adl-engine` crate over the landed compiler contract, with deterministic bounded scheduling, joins, retry, cancellation, typed provider/tool ports, capped state materialization, and strict checkpoint resume through bounded canonical turn replay. It does not change Runtime v2/v3 or add external-I/O authority.

All four FastWork PVF lanes pass, including 28 tests, strict clippy, fixture execution, COTS/source-boundary proof, deterministic resume, and LoC/time budgets. Fresh exact-revision review fixed and closed all nine findings.
